import std.io
import std.string

pub type AppError = Failed(String)

pub fn main() effect io -> Result<(), AppError> {
    let none: List<String> = []
    io.println(string.join(none, ","))
    let one: List<String> = ["a"]
    io.println(string.join(one, ","))
    let many: List<String> = ["a", "b", "c"]
    io.println(string.join(many, "-"))
    return Ok(())
}
